name: Клан — двенадцать эмблем паспорта и арена кланового босса (design/ui/screens/clan.js). Задача автора 29.09.2026: «Клан сейчас тоже одна большая заглушка по всем своим режимам, продумай его». НЕ ЗАПУСКАЛОСЬ: задание ждёт одобрения автора. Сейчас в прототипе заглушки: эмблема — векторный знак на щите, фон боя — арена Эхо недели расы. Эмблемы — стиль одобренных значков атрибутов (jobs/ui-attributes.json): 1:1, чёрный фон, ключ black, знак — около 80 % кадра, читается с 24 px. Арена — одна сцена 21:9, как арена Эхо (jobs/echo-ishkantun.json): карты героев слева, враг справа, перехода нет. Портретов врагов здесь нет: сонмы стихий — Голоса, Хозяева недели и их свита, 56 портретов — отдельное задание jobs/clan-foes.json (docs/content/клан.md, «Сонмы стихий»). Выгрузка после одобрения — строки в tools/art-gen/ui-art.json: design/ui/assets/art/clan/emblem-01…12.png, 256×256, fit 80; design/ui/assets/art/arena-clan.jpg

plan.Эмблемы: двенадцать знаков на выбор главы в паспорте клана. Порядок и мотивы — как у векторных заглушек EMB в screens/clan.js: щит, звезда, корона, пламя, капля, волна, ромб, песочные часы, знамя, книга, искра, глаз. Один набор: тот же маленький заострённый щит из тёмного кованого железа со старым золотом по кромке, внутри — один крупный знак; различаются только знак и цвет его света
plan.Цвет света знака: без привязки к стихиям и редкостям, чтобы эмблема не читалась как стихия клана: тёплое старое золото у всех, у пламени, капли и волны — свой свет стихии мягко, в глубине
plan.Арена: круглый зал из тёмного камня под городом, где клан встречает босса недели. Свет — только снизу, из жил карста в полу. Одна сцена: бой начинается и кончается здесь, камера не уходит в следующую комнату. Место боя — предложение, вопрос 15 черновика клана

notes: Место боя клана в своде лора не описано. Сцена ниже — нейтральная: зал без знаков, без надписей и без узнаваемых мест города. Если автор назовёт место — подменить subject арены
Портреты кланового босса девяти недель — после таблицы автора: имя, раса, стихия, облик. До неё в прототипе босс без портрета, в тумане стихии
Эмблемы сверяются с кристаллами редкостей и значками стихий: ни одна не должна повторять их форму — на щите нет кристалла-капли и медальона стихии
style: Dark fantasy game art with a menacing, gloomy, mystical atmosphere. Digital painting with soft transitions, elaborate shadows and an artistic emphasis on details. Lighting effects bring it to life: magical glow, aura and embers, light that comes from inside the subject and from below. Rich worn materials: dark forged iron, old gold, weathered stone, carst crystals glowing from within. Precious, dramatic, high contrast.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no glyphs, no hieroglyphs, no real-world scripts, no carvings that look like writing or numerals, no occult symbols, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture. No gore, no blood, no skulls, no sacrifice, no horror grotesque.
cutout_rule: The background is solid pure black ({hex}), flat, edge to edge: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow, no vignette, no checkerboard. Any glow stays close to the subject and fades into the black within a short distance. The whole icon with its glow fits inside the central 80% of the canvas in both width and height: an empty black margin of at least a tenth of the canvas stays on every side — top, bottom, left and right.

emblems.frame: Format: game UI emblem of a player guild, square, no border around the picture. One small pointed heraldic shield, upright, seen straight on, centered, about 80% of the canvas high: a plate of dark forged iron with a raised old-gold rim, slightly worn. On the shield — one large simple sign, raised in relief, that fills most of its face. The emblem floats on pitch black: everything around it is solid pure black to the very edges of the canvas, never white or grey, no frame. It must stay readable at a tiny size, 24 px: the shield outline and the sign are big simple shapes with strong contrast. All the painterly detail lives inside the silhouette — worn metal, old gold, light — never as small separate pieces around it: no sparks, embers or particles floating around. A crisp bright rim light runs along the whole outline and cleanly separates it from the black. The twelve emblems are one set: the same shield, the same size in the frame, the same painting; only the sign and the color of its light tell them apart.

arenas.frame: Format: wide horizontal battle background for a landscape phone screen, 21:9. Strict top-down orthographic view, the camera looks straight down at the ground like a tabletop RPG battle map: no horizon, no perspective, no side view of walls, no sky. The attached image is our battle arena of a different place, the Workshop of Forms: take from it ONLY the straight-down camera, the scale, the layout of the zones and the painting style. Do NOT copy its objects, materials or colors: no worktables, no clay figures, no crystals, no sand. The game puts its cards along the left and right sides: five hero cards in the left quarter and one big enemy card in the right quarter, from the top edge to the bottom edge. So the left quarter (0-25% of the width) and the right quarter (75-100% of the width) must be open, flat, evenly lit ground over their whole height: worn stone slabs and fine cracks only — no steps, no walls, no statues, no objects there. This arena is a single scene: the fight begins and ends here, the camera never moves on to a next room, so nothing in the picture leads onward — no doorway, no road, no stairway, no passage out of the picture. All details are placed only in the central half (25-75% of the width), close to the top and bottom edges; the middle of the central half stays calm and open, because the game shows banners there.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 1: щит
jobs.subject: The sign: a smaller second shield inside the shield — a raised inner shield of old gold with a bevelled edge, like a badge of steadfastness. Warm old-gold light (#DDBC7A) glows from the seam between the two shields. Solid, protective, calm.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 2: звезда
jobs.subject: The sign: a five-pointed star with thick blunt rays, raised in old gold, its center slightly domed. Warm old-gold light glows from the center of the star outward along the rays. Guiding, bright, steady.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 3: корона
jobs.subject: The sign: a simple open crown with three tall points and a broad band, raised in old gold, no jewels. Warm old-gold light glows along the top edge of the band. Proud, old, restrained.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 4: пламя
jobs.subject: The sign: a single tall tongue of flame with two smaller tongues at its base, raised in old gold. Deep inside the relief a soft ember-red light (#F0564A) glows, fading into gold at the edges. Fierce, alive.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 5: капля
jobs.subject: The sign: one large drop of water with a round belly and a sharp top, raised in old gold, a single curved highlight on its belly. Deep inside a soft cold blue light (#5A94F7) glows. Patient, deep.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 6: волна
jobs.subject: The sign: two parallel rolling waves, one above the other, broad and simple, raised in old gold. Between them a soft cold blue-green light glows. Moving, relentless.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 7: ромб
jobs.subject: The sign: a tall faceted rhombus of old gold — a cut stone seen straight on, with four broad facets, not a drop and not a medallion. Warm old-gold light glows from the central ridge. Hard, precious.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 8: песочные часы
jobs.subject: The sign: an hourglass with a thick frame of old gold, top and bottom plates wide, the glass bulbs dark; a thin thread of glowing sand falls between them, warm gold light. Patient, measured.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 9: знамя
jobs.subject: The sign: a tall banner pole with a swallow-tailed pennant flying to the right, raised in old gold, the cloth folds shown with two or three broad bends, no pattern on the cloth. Warm old-gold light runs along the pole. Gathering, marching.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 10: книга
jobs.subject: The sign: a closed thick book standing upright, its spine to the left, heavy corners, raised in old gold, no symbols on the cover. A soft turquoise light (#48E5D4) seeps from between the pages. Wise, keeping.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 11: искра
jobs.subject: The sign: a four-pointed spark with long vertical rays and shorter horizontal rays, raised in old gold, a bright core. Warm white-gold light bursts softly from the core. Sudden, hopeful.

jobs.title: Эмблема клана 12: глаз
jobs.subject: The sign: a single open almond-shaped eye seen straight on, a round iris, no lashes, raised in old gold, calm and watchful, not menacing. A soft old-gold light glows in the iris. Vigilant.

jobs.title: Арена кланового босса — 21:9, одна сцена без перехода; место — предложение, ждёт автора
jobs.source: GDD §25; docs/content/клан.md, вопрос 15; раскладка — jobs/arena-02.json, jobs/echo-ishkantun.json
jobs.subject: Subject: a great round hall of dark stone deep under the city, seen straight from above — the place where a guild of wanderers meets the enemy of the week. It is dark, as dark as our Workshop arena: the floor is large worn slabs of dark grey stone in deep shadow, laid in wide concentric rings, and the light comes only from below — from thin veins of carst crystal in the seams of the slabs, glowing cold turquoise, and from a few wide iron braziers with low amber embers. In the central half only: along the top edge, the lower ends of tall banner poles of dark iron standing in a row, their cloth hanging down plain and dark, with no signs or patterns, cut off by the top edge of the picture; along the bottom edge, a wide low stone ring of a dry old basin, only its upper half visible, its rim worn smooth, carst light glowing in its cracks; near the poles and the basin, two iron braziers with amber embers and thin curls of pale smoke; a few heavy iron chains lying loose on the slabs. Along the very top and bottom edges runs a thin strip of rough dark rock, no more than 7% of the height. Near-black shadows, cold turquoise carst light; the only warm color is the amber glow of the braziers. No characters, no animals, no bodies, no cards, no grid, no symbols on the banners.
